details.purpose: To record details about the provision of a health assessment at clinically relevant events in the intervention lifecycle, from planning to completion, and including deviations or interruptions.
details.keywords: assessment, screening, evaluation, checkup, prevention, wellness, monitoring, review, development
details.use:
Use to record details about the provision of a health assessment at clinically relevant events in the intervention lifecycle, from planning to completion, and including deviations or interruptions.
The scope of this archetype is focused on the provision of any health assessment to the individual, including by other service providers. It includes, but is not limited to: - Comprehensive assessments, such as a general health check-up, an annual 'medical' or a pre-employment medical assessment. - Age- or gender-specific assessments, such as child and adolescent developmental checks, over 75 health assessment or gender specific health checks. - Condition-specific assessments, such as cardiovascular risk assessment, cancer screening, mental health screening - Functional assessments, such as activities of daily living, falls risk assessment, Timed Up and Go test (TUG), or Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) - Health risk appraisals, such as lifestyle and behaviour risk assessments (smoking, alcohol, diet, exercise, gambling) - Targeted clinical assessments - Mental health plan review, Asthma annual review, or Medication review. - Community or population-based assessments, such as a first nations health check, school-entry health screening.
Record one instance per careflow step or event for each specified health assessment, in a health record. If the assessment to be provided consists of a single component, the 'Assessment provided' and the 'Assessment completed' careflow step may be recorded simultaneously. However, if the assessment consists of multiple components, record a separate instance of the 'Assessment provided' careflow step for each component delivered, and record the 'Assessment completed' step only after the final component has been provided.

items.items: Health assessment

Provision of a health assessment required to evaluate an individual’s physical, mental, developmental, or functional health status, for the purposes of prevention, screening, diagnosis, or care planning.
Item tree
@ internal @
Assessment name
Name of the assessment, or type of assessment.

For example: neonatal hip dysplasia screening, Adverse Childhood Experiences (ACE) screening, pre-employment medical, interRAI Community Health Assessment, medication review, Mini Mental State Examination (MMSE), or a cardiovascular risk assessment. Use of a clinical terminology is recommended whenever possible. Free text entry should be allowed only when an appropriate coded value is not available.
Category
An overarching grouping for the health assessment identified in 'Assessment name'.
For example: comprehensive, age-specific, condition-specific, functional, or population.
Description
Narrative description about the provision of the health assessment, applicable to the careflow step.
Clinical indication
The clinical reason for the health assessment.
For example: diabetes control; or cancer treatment'. Coding of the indication with a terminology is preferred, where possible. This data element allows multiple occurrences.
Additional details
Additional structured details about the health assessment provision.
Scheduled date/time
The intended date and/or time for delivery of the equipment.
This data element must only be used in conjunction with the 'Assessment scheduled' careflow step.
Comment
Additional narrative about the supply activity or careflow step not captured in other fields.
Assessment planned
An intent or need to initiate a health assessment process has been recognised; active careflow steps have not commenced.
Assessment postponed
The planned assessment has been temporarily stopped; active careflow steps have not commenced.
Item tree
@ internal @
Assessment cancelled
The planned assessment has been permanently stopped; active careflow steps have not commenced.
Assessment scheduled
A date and/or time has been scheduled for the planned assessment; active careflow steps have not commenced.
Assessment provided
The assessment has been provided; active careflow steps are in process.

If the assessment consists of a single component, this careflow step and the 'Assessment completed' step may be recorded simultaneously. If the assessment consists of multiple components, record a separate instance of this careflow step for each component provided, and record the 'Assessment completed' step only after the final component has been delivered.
Assessment suspended
The active assessment process has been temporarily stopped; active careflow steps have been put on hold.
Assessment abandoned
The active assessment process has been permanently stopped; active careflow steps have been aborted.
Assessment completed
All components of the assessment have been provided; active careflow steps have been completed.
If the equipment to be supplied consists of a single component, this careflow step and the 'Assessment provided' step may be recorded simultaneously.
Extension
Additional information required to extend the model with local content or to align with other reference models or formalisms.
For example: local information requirements; or additional metadata to align with FHIR.
